title: CampaignReport
description: One report per campaign run, listing every finding that run opened. This is the artifact a human reviews after a run and before approving anything. It is composed deterministically from durable rows — verdicts, findings and the run summary — so recomposing it from the same state yields the same bytes; it contains no narrative the platform invented. It does not replace the per-finding VulnReport, which remains the unit the regression and replay lifecycle tracks; this aggregates them for review.

run_state.description: How the run ended. A report is written for an aborted or failed run too, because those runs still produced findings a reviewer must see. Recording the state is what stops an early-ended run from being read as full coverage of the corpus.

totals.description: Counts projected from durable verdict and finding rows. operational_error_count is reported so a reviewer can see how much of the run was NOT adjudicated; an ERROR is an operational fault and never a security signal.

findings.description: Every finding this run opened, ordered deterministically by source case. Empty when a run found nothing, which is a real and reportable result rather than a missing report.

confirmation_status.description: Carried per finding rather than only in aggregate. A run mixing a confirmed finding with candidates must not let the confirmed one lend its authority to the rest.

rationale.description: The model evaluator's advisory reasoning, reproduced verbatim from the verdict. Advisory for a confirmed finding and the sole basis for a candidate; in neither case is it a confirmation.

report_id.description: The per-finding VulnReport, when one was drafted. Absent rather than invented when it was not.
